conversation.description: Chat scroll container that follows the stream, lets go when you scroll up and shows a jump-to-latest pill with a new-message count.

message-branch.title: Message Branch
message-branch.description: Flip between regenerated answers or edited prompts with a directional blur slide and a 2 / 3 switcher.

web-preview.title: Web Preview
web-preview.description: Browser frame for generated apps: address bar, history, device widths, reload, loading skeleton and a console drawer.

artifact-panel.title: Artifact Panel
artifact-panel.description: Side canvas for generated code and documents with preview and code tabs, version history, copy, download and full screen.

context-meter.title: Context Meter
context-meter.description: Ring that shows how full the context window is, with token breakdown, estimated cost and a compact action.
